summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a large obfuscated bundle
details: example-js-project@1.0.2 declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the bun binary to 0755, then execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle (header // @bun @bun-cjs) built as a rotated opcode/string-array with hex-mangled _0x identifiers, so its behavior is not inspectable in the shipped form. The install chain deliberately fetches an alternate language runtime that Node-based inspection would not exercise, and uses it to run an obfuscated payload on npm install without any user action beyond installation. Package metadata is generic (empty author/description, unrelated declared dependencies), and the declared purpose does not require an alternate runtime to complete installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
